name: Sanctions & coercion
value: EU readies Iran cyber sanctions; FAC 16 Nov
summary: EU says it is finalising cyber sanctions on Iran over supermarket hacks; ministers met 16 Nov, no outcome published yet
state: After France attributed October cyberattacks on refrigeration systems at hundreds of European supermarkets to Iran, the EU said on 10 Nov it was finalising new cyber sanctions and was ready for a rapid, united response (Demócrata; Europa Press). EU foreign ministers met in Brussels on 16 Nov with the issue open for discussion; no outcome had been published by 17:45 UTC (Council of the EU). No major economy cut off from payment systems or large seizure of sovereign assets was found, so Watch holds.
for_you: Firms trading with Iran or handling Iranian-linked payments face a growing list of EU, UK and US restrictions; UK businesses can check OFSI guidance.
rubric_hit: Watch: new EU sanctions package on Iran in preparation; no payment-system cut-off or sovereign asset seizure
